input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Corio (our party). Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce" and "employ" return no restrictive-covenant language: Section 10 (Confidentiality) defers entirely to the separate NDA; Section 13 (Shared Resources) addresses only Employee NDA/Invention Agreements, ownership of Developments and a covenant not to sue in respect of Commerce One personnel working alongside Corio; Section 14 (Miscellaneous) covers assignment, governing law, notices, independent contractors, severability, force majeure, subcontracting, bankruptcy and integration; and Exhibit D Section 5 merely requires each party to assign a sales/marketing employee to the promotional activity. The integration clause confirms the four corners of the deal, so no non-solicit is imported by reference. This matches the playbook's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is required.
